0022600114.text: Orlando (0-2, 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back) visits New York (0-2, 12th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 2 games back) with both teams still winless this season. The Magic are without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Paolo Banchero is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, averaging 35.0 points and 41.2 minutes per game this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Orlando's last meeting was a 132-120 loss in Orlando on December 13, 2025, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
